snippet.title: Project Motor Racing | Official Gameplay 2
snippet.description:
Cross-play means everyone races on the same physics.
Wheel or pad — run what you’ve got.

Here’s raw gameplay on a standard gamepad, assists on.
Proof you don’t need a wheel to be fast. (Or slow, like our socials guy!)

Project Motor Racing launches worldwide on November 25, 2025, for PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S. 

Pre-order Project Motor Racing and receive the GTE vehicle pack as a special bonus. 

Pre-order the Year 1 Bundle and receive the bonus GTE pack PLUS save up to 30% compared to buying all content separately.

► Pre-Order Project Motor Racing now: https://projectmotorracing.com/buy-now.php
► Learn more on our website: https://projectmotorracing.com/ 

► Get more information on our Social Media channels 
► Instagram    /  https://www.instagram.com/projectmotorracing/
